faq.question: How does Wasp’s Static Barrier work?
faq.answer:
Static Barrier divides the map into 2 regions: spaces within its radius and outside its radius. Enemy units are restricted by the “barrier” as follows:
• ❌They cannot take a move action (to move or fast travel) to move across the barrier.
• ❌They cannot use an attack or skill involving movement to cross the barrier.
• ❌They cannot end any movement on the other side of the barrier - even if they are allowed to “move through obstacles”.
• ❌They cannot push units through the barrier unless the push is “ignoring obstacles” - in which case the target still has to reach an empty space.
• ✅They can use a “swap” effect to cross the barrier and remain on the other side.
• ✅They can perform an attack that targets a unit on the other side of the barrier.
Reminder: These restrictions only apply when an enemy hero is taking the action.

faq.question: How does Wasp’s ability move units and tokens?
faq.answer: The target cannot move farther away or closer, so the distance between you and the target must remain unchanged.

faq.question: When does Wasp’s  push ability force a discard?
faq.answer: This card pushes adjacent enemies away from you (in a straight line). If an enemy Hero cannot be pushed the full distance, because an obstacle is located along the straight line path, the Hero is forced to discard.

faq.question: Why do Wasp’s Tier II and III abilities say “If you do”? Why would the block fail?
faq.answer: You can always discard a card to attempt to defend, even if it does not defend successfully.

faq.question: Does Wasp’s Gold prevent movement?
faq.answer: No, Wasp’s dagger interferes with magical placement abilites – and only if they are controlled by enemy heroes. Normal movement and pushes can still be used by enemy heroes to reposition.

faq.question: Can enemies from further away use their placement abilities to approach Wasp?
faq.answer: Yes, the ability does not prevent enemey heroes from placing or swapping themselfs (or their friends) into the radius of Wasp’s dagger.

faq.question: What are Obstacles?
faq.answer:
Obstacles are basically anything on the map: Units (Heroes and Minions), terrain shown on the map, tokens, and any other miniatures. There can only be one Obstacle on each space, and Obstacles generally can’t move through each other.
If an ability does allow Obstacles to pass through each other (“you can move through Obstacles”, ignore Obstacles”, “Heroes may move through a space with a tree token”), they still may not end movement on such a space.
Any space with an Obstacle is considered occupied and not empty.

lore: As all heiresses to the throne of the Gilded Empire, Wasp was exiled from the palace as soon as she could hold a dagger. She needs to learn to control her powers before she can face the ultimate challenge and claim her birthright.
